_comment: Scripted-scenario pack (Calradia Remembers). Each rule is a stateless reactive rule in the keyword DSL: when its trigger fires and its guards pass, its consequences mutate the world and its message is dropped into the world-event store (told in-game by rumor/chronicle). Every rule whose trigger fires plays, in reading order, if it is ready at its turn: not already sealed, its guards pass, and every one of its consequences can really apply (a war between realms already at war cannot, so the rule waits and its message is not told). Rules sharing a "group" are alternatives: one of them is drawn by weight. Triggers: ON_DEATH, ON_MARRIAGE, ON_WAR_DECLARED, ON_PEACE (the player or context hero/faction is matched by guards). Guards (AND-combined): IF_HERO_IS:<id or name> (who the event is about: for a death the one who died, never the killer; for a marriage either spouse), IF_PLAYER_INVOLVED, IF_PLAYER_RULES, IF_PLAYER_IS_FEMALE/MALE, IF_PLAYER_AT_WAR:<faction>, IF_AT_WAR:A,B, IF_AT_PEACE:A,B, IF_ALIVE:<hero>, IF_KINGDOM_EXISTS:<kingdom>, IF_RULES:<hero>,<kingdom>. Consequences: DECLARE_WAR:A,B  MAKE_PEACE:A,B  CHANGE_RELATION:HeroRef:+N  CHANGE_INFLUENCE:HeroRef:+N  INJECT_MEMORY:HeroRef:text. Name heroes and kingdoms by their game id (lord_1_14 is Rhagaea; empire, empire_w, empire_s are the Northern, Western and Southern Empires): the game translates names, so a name only works in one language. Test from console with: cr.scenario_fire ON_DEATH Rhagaea

rules.message: With the empress Rhagaea fallen, the eagles of the North and West turn upon a leaderless South.
